title: Coast Guard, Navy conduct joint rescue of crewman from research vessel Kilo Moana off Oahu
description: A 55-year-old crewman from the research vessel Kilo Moana is hoisted 175 miles northeast of Kaneohe Bay by a Navy MH-60 Seahawk crew from Helicopter Maritime Strike Squadron 37 from Marine Corps Base Hawaii, Oahu, Aug. 8, 2017. The crewman, suffering from a severe foot injury, arrived safely to MCB Hawaii where he was met by awaiting emergency medical personnel for further transport to Queens Medical Center. A Coast Guard HC-130 Hercules crew from Air Station Barbers Point flew cover and provided additional communications. (U.S. Coast Guard video by Air Station Barbers Point/Released).
keywords: Oahu, D14, USN, Hawaii, navy, medevac, SAR, USCG
